output_list.criticism: The function always returns the same result, which can be misinterpreted as fraudulent behavior.

If two people buy the same token from the same time in the same block, one may get the extra token as reward for buying the same token, considering the value is 0.03 token or 1 token, the buyer receives 1.03 tokens instead of the expected 1.03 tokens or 3 tokens. This misrepresents the fairness of the token distribution.
